question_stem:
An ideal gas initially has pressure 1.0 × 10^{5} Pa, volume 4.0 × 10^{-4} m^{3} and temperature 300 K, as
illustrated in Fig. 2.1.
A change in energy of the gas of 240 J results in an increase of pressure to a final value of
5.0 × 10^{5} Pa at constant volume.
The thermodynamic temperature becomes T.
